posts.name: Ashish Kumar
posts.cooked:
I have completed all the BPTs in the previous System Command course, and now I am repeating the course. Since I have already completed all BPTs (1, 2, and 3), when I run the command synchro eval, it passes and shows 100% in BPT 1, but it shows absent for BPT 2 and BPT 3.

image196×146 2.55 KB

image1314×486 190 KB

posts.name: Atharv Sanjeev Kumar
posts.cooked: since u are repeating u were supposed to submit them again , u only did it for BPT-1 not for 2 and 3

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: If you are repeating OPPE, you have to run synchro eval for all questions within the deadline for this term. Since you did run synchro eval for BPT1 that’s why it shows 100 for that. For BPT 2 & 3, you didn’t run synchro eval within this term’s deadline that’s why it shows absent. Submissions will only be considered for this term and not from previous term.

posts.cooked: I already made a request on this issue, i have submitted BPT3 within the deadline but it is shown as absent. Please help me. Today i have submitted BPT4 also.
